summary: The invocation return value shows how the module was invoked, including the full module_args after defaults are applied.
questions: How can I see which arguments a module actually received?

answer_card.title: invocation return value
answer_card.answer_md: **`invocation.module_args`** lists all arguments the module ran with, defaults included (e.g. `backup`, `mode`, `dest`, `src`). Useful for debugging; view it with `-v` or by registering the result.
